nap.title: The next nap, already worked out.
nap.subtitle: Nappa learns your baby’s rhythm and predicts the next nap and feed. No maths at 3am.

feed.title: Log it in one tap. Even half asleep.
feed.subtitle: Naps, feeds and nappies in a single tap. Fix the time later if you need to.

family.title: Everyone who helps, on the same page.
family.subtitle: Invite a partner, grandparent or nanny. Every log syncs to everyone straight away.

about.subtitle: A first name is plenty. You can add a photo later.

about.birthdayHint: Predictions are matched to her age.
about.guardianGeneric: I’m the parent or legal guardian
about.twinsUnavailable: You can set up one baby in this version.

feeding.title: How is {{name}} fed right now?
feeding.subtitle: Pick the closest. You can change it any time.

wake.title: When did {{name}} last wake up?
wake.subtitle: This sets her first prediction. A rough guess is fine.
wake.hint: Not sure? Nappa corrects itself as you log naps.

carers.title: Who else looks after {{name}}?
carers.subtitle: We’ll set up invites once you’re in. Nothing is sent yet.

reminders.title: Want a nudge before naps?
